title: Comprehensive Python architecture review and refactor
status_detail: Created at human request as an inactive parent Task with six ordered phase children; future phase descendants remain deliberately undetermined and require separate recording and activation.
objective: Review and incrementally refactor the maintained Python architecture into cohesive modules and explicit behavior owners with deliberate supported imports, enforceable conformance, and only demonstrated abstraction boundaries.
authorized_scope: Coordinate the inactive inventory-and-policy, architecture-conformance, public-import-boundary, module-decomposition, abstraction-design, and aggregate-verification phases without implementing them merely because this parent exists.

Preserve accepted scientific meaning, package ownership, dependency direction, public and wire contracts, evidence meaning, and unrelated work unless a later explicitly activated phase records the applicable authority for a change.
Create future phase descendants only after current evidence identifies a cohesive package, module, contract, or verification boundary; do not predeclare speculative grandchildren.

Treat parent relationships as containment only, phase prerequisites as required closed results, and every activation, material public-contract decision, implementation, review, and closeout as separately governed.
completion_criteria: All six phase Tasks have completed under their own exact scopes and actual prerequisite results, with no automatically activated descendant.

Maintained Python source has cohesive module and submodule responsibilities, explicit callable ownership, deliberate supported import surfaces, and documented residual limitations under the accepted Phase 1 policy.

Applicable source, tests, typing, documentation, public-import checks, architecture conformance, generated projections, and Harness validation agree without unsupported scientific or compatibility claims.
Administrative closeout records the accepted aggregate result, preserves unrelated work, and leaves automatic successor activation disabled.
exclusions: This recording does not activate a phase, authorize source refactoring, select a private-method or compatibility policy, or create future package-specific child Tasks.
Do not create a generic utility hierarchy, nominal DataObject or ActionObject base, or abstract class solely to satisfy naming or shared-method similarity.

Do not change scientific settings, mathematical conventions, serialized meaning, dependencies, protected execution, release state, publication state, or retained historical evidence without separate applicable authority.
No staging, commit, push, automatic succession, or unrelated selected-Task mutation is authorized.
